name: Deep Work Mornings
excerpt: Jordan suggested deep work in the mornings to improve productivity.
notes: Inspired by Jordan's suggestion, the writer restructures their work schedule to protect mornings for focused, deep work. This change leads to increased productivity and a more effective approach to the StoryGraph Project.
context_summary: - Suggested by Jordan to improve productivity.
- Led the writer to restructure their work schedule.
- Protecting mornings for deep work increased productivity.
